title: Senior Engineer Planning & Scheduling - PED
description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
The Engineer is responsible for providing comprehensive project controls leadership across planning, scheduling, cost management, budgeting, forecasting, risk assessment, and performance reporting for EPC and capital projects. The role ensures projects are executed within approved cost and schedule baselines through effective monitoring, analysis, stakeholder coordination, and implementation of project control best practices, while delivering accurate forecasting, commercial insights, and management information to support informed decision-making and successful project delivery.
  
  
At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
Team
  
  

Making an impact.
**What will you do?**

* In this role, you will develop, maintain, and manage detailed baseline project schedules covering all phases, milestones, and deliverables while ensuring alignment with project objectives and execution plans.
* Additionally, you will monitor project progress against approved schedules, identify variances, track performance metrics, and implement timely corrective actions to achieve planned targets.
* Furthermore, you will perform critical path analysis, evaluate schedule risks and delays, assess their impact on project timelines, and recommend effective recovery and mitigation strategies.
* Meanwhile, you will coordinate closely with Project Managers, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless execution, schedule integration, and effective communication across all project functions.
* Consequently, you will plan and optimize the utilization of manpower, equipment, and materials, ensuring resources are allocated efficiently to support project requirements and milestone achievement.
* Moreover, you will manage schedule updates and scope changes, evaluate their impact on project timelines and deliverables, and maintain accurate planning records in compliance with organizational standards and best practices.
* Finally, you will prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, forecasts, dashboards, and performance updates while supporting project controls and cost management activities to ensure successful project delivery.

Winning in your role.
**Do you have what it takes?**

* You must have a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline, along with 6 to 12 years of relevant experience in project planning, scheduling, and project controls.

**Why you will love working for us!**
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company, operating in more than 100 countries worldwide. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.
  
  
On the 1st of April 2020, Linde India Limited and Praxair India Private Limited successfully formed a joint venture, LSAS Services Private Limited. This company will provide Operations and Management (O&M) services to both existing organizations, which will continue to operate separately. LSAS carries forward the commitment towards sustainable development, championed by both legacy organizations. It also takes ahead the tradition of the development of processes and technologies that have revolutionized the industrial gases industry, serving a variety of end markets including chemicals & refining, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, and primary metals.
  
  
At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
  
  
Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
Linde India Limited acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.

title: Financieel Assistent Agro (24–40 uur)
description:
Wegens groei van de organisatie zijn wij op zoek naar een:
  
  
Financieel Assistent Agro (24–40 uur)
  
  
Over de functie
  
  
In deze functie ga jij het verschil maken richting ondernemers in de agrarische sector. Je krijgt gezonde dosis verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte voor ontwikkeling en dagelijks direct contact met klanten.
  
  
Als Financieel Assistent werk je in een hecht en betrokken team, waar jouw kennis en inzet direct bijdragen aan het succes van onze klanten. Je krijgt de vrijheid om je eigen werk in te richten en de kans om te groeien, zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk.
  
  
Wat ga je doen
  
  

* Zelfstandig samenstellen van (complexere) jaarrekeningen en tussentijdse cijfers.
* Opstellen van belastingaangiften (o.a. omzet-, inkomsten-, vennootschaps- en dividendbelasting).
* Signaleren van kansen en knelpunten voor klanten en deze vertalen naar praktisch advies.
* Opstellen van managementrapportages en ondersteunen bij klantbesprekingen.
* Actieve rol spelen in klantcontact: je bent aanspreekpunt en sparringpartner.
* Begeleiden en ondersteunen van junior collega’s en het delen van jouw kennis.
* Bijhouden van vaktechnische ontwikkelingen en meedenken over verbeteringen in processen.

Kortom: een veelzijdige functie waarin je verder kijkt dan cijfers alleen en écht impact maakt voor ondernemers.
  
  
Over het team
  
  
Je komt te werken in een betrokken en zelfsturend team bestaande uit ongeveer 50 collega’s, verdeeld over twee locaties; Staphorst en Hattemerbroek. Wij werken voor een diverse klantenkring waaronder het MKB en de Agrarische sector. Onze cultuur is open, sociaal en gedreven. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat we ondernemers écht verder helpen – en dat doen we met plezier.
  
  
Wat neem je mee
  
  

* Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in Accountancy, Bedrijfseconomie, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare financiële richting.
* Bij voorkeur 1 à 2 jaar relevante werkervaring in de samenstelpraktijk.
* Goede communicatieve en analytische vaardigheden: je spreekt de taal van de ondernemer.
* Affiniteit en/of belangstelling voor de agrarische sector
* Je bent proactief, kwaliteitsgericht en een echte teamspeler.

Wat krijg je van ons
  
  

* Een uitstekend salaris afhankelijk van je ervaring, aangevuld met vakantietoeslag, pensioen en aantrekkelijke secundaire voorwaarden.
* Flexibiliteit in je werkweek: de mogelijkheid om 24, 32, 36 of 40 uur te werken en je werkdagen zelf in te delen.
* Ruimte voor ontwikkeling: studiefaciliteiten, opleidingen, performance coaching en begeleiding van ervaren collega’s.
* Vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid: meedenken met klanten, initiatief nemen en eigen ideeën uitwerken.
* Direct perspectief: uitzicht op een vast contract en doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen de organisatie.

Reageer direct!
  
  
Ben jij enthousiast geworden na het lezen van deze mooie vacature? Neem dan contact op met ons: 0522 – 462 495 of stuur je sollicitatie met CV naar: tinabouwhuis@harke.nl. Wij nemen dan zo spoedig mogelijk contact met je op. Bekijk onze website: www.harke.nl

description:

Drive the planning, execution, and delivery of branch and office fit-out projects to support the bank’s real estate expansion strategy. Ensure timely, cost-effective, and high-quality infrastructure rollout with continuous value optimization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution of fit-out projects (branches, offices, refurbishments)
* Ensure adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards
* Manage project lifecycle from concept to handover

* Oversee BOQs, specifications, drawings, and vendor deliverables

* Act as the single point of contact for internal stakeholders

* Drive cross-functional coordination for seamless delivery

* Monitor budgets, forecasts, and financial performance
* Drive cost optimization and efficiency initiatives

**Vendor & Compliance Management**

* Manage contractors, consultants, and vendors for effective execution
* Ensure compliance with internal policies, statutory norms, and approvals

**Reporting & Governance**

* Provide regular updates on project status, risks, and financials
* Maintain documentation including timelines, approvals, and cash flows

**Continuous Improvement**

* Contribute to portfolio strategy, process improvements, and best practices
* Support real estate strategy through insights on cost, design, and efficiency

**Eligibility Criteria**
**Experience**

* 6–10 years of experience in commercial real estate / fit-out project management
* Proven experience in independently managing multiple projects

**Education**

* Graduate (mandatory)
* B.E./B.Tech (Civil / Electrical / Mechanical) preferred

**Core Competencies**

* Strong project management and execution skills
* Analytical, structured, and solution-oriented thinking
* Understanding of leased real estate processes (preferred)
* Experience with statutory approvals and regulatory bodies
* Ability to work under pressure in dynamic environments

**Technical Skills**

* BOQ preparation, technical specifications, and drawing review

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

* High ownership, adaptability, and resilience

title: Relationship Manager - GL West
description:

Bhucho Mandi - Kanichia Road
  
  
**Job Purpose**
"This position is open with Bajaj finance limited"
  
  
The Branch manager is a managerial responsibility for providing full leadership and direction to the team of employees in growing business and client base of consumer gold loan. The overall objective of this role is to build customer loyalty and recommend the development of business strategies or initiatives and may include the management of activities by external organizations, and the direct management of individuals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive & participate in field-marketing activities of various financial products along with the team to improve brand visibility

Education & Skill Qualifications:
  
  

* 4-7 years of relevant experience required.
* Bachelor’s Degree/Post-graduation Degree preferred.
* Previous experience in gold loan banking, gold loan products, management or client service preferred.
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills.

title: Head, GCFO AI Lead(Singapore, India)
description: Job SummaryThis role could be based in Singapore or India. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based. The GCFO AI lead is accountable for transforming the Finance operating model through process excellence, re-engineering, intelligent automation, and artificial intelligence. The role leads the redesign and optimization of GCFO's end-to-end processes, controls, data, and operating model, embedding simplified, standardized, and scalable ways of working across the function. As the architect of Finance transformation, the role drives continuous improvement, productivity, control effectiveness, and digital innovation, creating a highly efficient, insight-led, and AI-enabled Finance organisation. Beyond GCFO, the role serves as the senior Finance representative across Bank-wide AI and transformation initiatives, ensuring GCFO priorities are reflected in the enterprise AI agenda while accelerating the adoption of responsible AI, automation, and emerging technologies across the function. The role partners with Technology, Data, Operations, Risk, and Business leaders to identify enterprise use cases, influence investment priorities, and scale innovation that delivers measurable business value.Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy Define and own the GCFO Process Excellence and AI Strategy, establishing a clear vision for a future-state Finance platform that is integrated, scalable, resilient, data-driven, and AI-enabled. Shape and deliver the long-term GCFO transformation agenda, translating strategic objectives into a coherent platform roadmap with clear outcomes, milestones, investment priorities, and measurable business value. Serve as the Finance and Treasury champion for enterprise-wide AI transformation, representing GCFO across Bank-wide AI initiatives, influencing cross-functional priorities, and ensuring alignment with the Bank's AI strategy. Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Risk, Technology, Operations, Data, and the Businesses to identify, prioritize, and scale AI opportunities that deliver sustainable productivity, control, and commercial benefits. Architect future-ready operating models that support business growth, enhance organizational agility, and reduce complexity, operational risk, and cost. Champion intelligent automation and digital transformation through the adoption of workflow technologies, RPA, AI/ML, agentic capabilities, and next-generation productivity solutions. Ensure alignment with Group Finance, Risk, Technology, Data, and regulatory strategies while maintaining strong governance, controls, resilience, and audit readiness across both traditional and digital-asset environments. Contribute to the development of the Bank's AI standards, governance frameworks, control environment, and Responsible AI practices, ensuring safe, ethical, and compliant adoption of AI across the enterprise. Monitor emerging AI technologies, regulatory developments, and industry-leading practices, identifying opportunities that advance Finance and Treasury capabilities while strengthening the Bank's competitive advantage.Business Strengthen GCFO’s business partnering model with Finance, Risk, Technology, and the wider business. Intelligence Layer: Deliver AI-enabled capabilities including Knowledge Graphs, vector stores, RAG, Digital Twins, LLMs, and Agents to enable advanced analytics and decision support across finance and digital-asset domains. Develop future-ready GCFO talent and act as an evangelist for GCFO digital enablement, and AI adoption.Risk Management Reinforce an exemplary risk and control culture across all GCFO platforms and processes, including those supporting digital assets and tokenised products. Maintain compliance with key regulatory and financial reporting standards. Strengthen the control environment while driving process simplification and efficiency.
